description: Scrapes Instagram profile statistics and recent posts for any list of accounts using apidojo's Instagram scraper on Apify. Triggers when the user asks to: get Instagram profile data for an account, fetch follower count and post count for Instagram users, scrape Instagram bio and stats in bulk, export Instagram account metadata, check profile information for a list of Instagram handles, or get engagement data from Instagram profiles. Returns username, follower count, following count, post count, bio, and recent post metrics. Ideal for influencer vetting, brand research, and list enrichment.
